complete_closure_policy.validation_entrypoint_identity: complete_closure module, acceptance alias, package API and CLI share one immutable aggregate-bounded snapshot wrapper
complete_closure_policy.runtime_authority: public validation uses current trusted system time and canonical OpenSSL command; caller time and executable overrides are rejected before evidence reads
complete_closure_policy.contract_semantic_binding: issuer, evidence-set and reviewer digests bind the canonical SHA-256 of the complete current contract object in addition to its revision label
complete_closure_policy.committed_accepted_envelope_discovery: recursive content identity under evidence/external using O_NOFOLLOW and stable lexical/opened/post-read descriptor identity

authority_owned.closure_rule: Every authority class named for a gap signs exactly its versioned class-scoped claims through a distinct pinned key and identity/organization pair; every issuer and reviewer binds the canonical contract digest; every final reviewer binds the same policy, review roster and acceptance context; public validation owns its clock and cryptographic executable selection; every committed accepted envelope is discovered recursively by stable descriptor-backed content and revalidated under an out-of-band pin; real external evidence and independent acceptance remain required.

claim_ceiling: G10 closes repository-controlled authority quorum, claim-scope/version binding, canonical-contract content binding, final-review-set integrity, trusted runtime authority, canonical validation-entrypoint identity, and stable committed accepted-envelope discovery only; it cannot manufacture E5-E7, administrative, upstream, physical, provider, vendor, independent-assurance, signing, pilot, store, or release authority.
